Class DEditAttributeInfo

java.lang.Object

public class DEditAttributeInfo

Makes a new DEditAttributeInfo with given paramet. In the XML it would appear ... where name is String name and value is String value. The type of value should be one of DEditAttributeInfo.STRING, .BOOLEAN, .INTEGER, or .FLOAT.

Parameters:
type - the DEditDataType of the attribute
name - the name of the attribute
value - the value of the attribute
